description: Phase 3 rql-full-v1 surface corpus: compile accept/refuse + execute attach oracles. Not package accept. Residuals: at rank/access (DDA), index pushdown, remote enrich wire, root re-page after post-attach where.

accept.source_rql: from orders enrich customer using customers matching customer_id = id expect exactly_one page size 10

from orders enrich items using line_items matching order_id = order_id expect many within items as item { enrich product using products as candidate matching item.product_id = candidate.id expect exactly_one }

from orders enrich items using line_items matching order_id = order_id expect many within items as item { where item.qty > 1 enrich product using products as candidate matching item.product_id = candidate.id expect exactly_one }
from orders where status = "paid" enrich customer using customers matching customer_id = id expect exactly_one where customer.country = "TH"

from orders enrich items using line_items matching order_id = order_id expect many within items as item { enrich product using products as candidate matching item.product_id = candidate.id expect exactly_one } enrich customer using customers matching customer_id = id expect exactly_one

from orders enrich items using line_items matching order_id = order_id expect many within items as item { enrich parts using components matching item.sku = parent_sku expect many within item.parts as part { enrich product using products as candidate matching part.product_id = candidate.id expect exactly_one } }
from orders enrich customer using customers matching customer_id = id expect exactly_one project { order_id, customer { name } } page size 32
from orders enrich customer using customers matching customer_id = id where active = true expect exactly_one

refuse.source_rql: from orders enrich customer using customers matching customer_id = id expect exactly_one
from orders within a { within b { within c { within d { within e { within f { within g { within h { within i { enrich x using products matching a = b expect optional } } } } } } } } }

execute.source_rql: from orders enrich customer using customers matching customer_id = id expect exactly_one project { order_id, customer { name } } page size 64

from orders enrich items using line_items matching order_id = order_id expect many within items as item { enrich product using products as candidate matching item.product_id = candidate.id expect exactly_one } page size 64
from orders where status = "paid" enrich customer using customers matching customer_id = id expect exactly_one where customer.country = "TH" page size 64
